title: TOP 5 STOCKS TO WATCH THIS WEEK | CPI REPORT
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: A hotter-than-expected CPI would raise the (18.4%) odds of a Fed hike and likely trigger a market drop; markets may de-risk into the report.
Nasdaq is bullish but overbought and at the high end of a resistance range; proceed with caution this week.
Big disconnect: AI/hyperscaler names at highs while well-known consumer names (Netflix, Nike, Lulu, McDonald's) sit in bear markets.

calls.condition: If CPI comes in hot, markets likely drop
calls.reason: Nasdaq bullish but overbought at the upper end of a resistance range; thinks consolidation is setting up a pullback, unconfirmed.
calls.quote: we're a little bit on the you know um higher end of this common resistance range

calls.condition: Drops if CPI is bad and markets fall
